experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic basilica with a skip-the-line guided tour, including tower access for panoramic views of the Eixample district. Book a morning slot for the best light through the stained glass windows.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter Architecture Walk
experiences.description: Self-guided or small-group walking tour through the Barri Gòtic, discovering Roman ruins, medieval palaces, and hidden plazas. Stay centrally located in El Born or Gothic Quarter hotels to walk directly to the starting point.

experiences.name: Palau de la Música Catalana Evening Concert
experiences.description: Attend a live concert inside this UNESCO-listed Modernista masterpiece designed by Lluís Domènech i Montaner. The ornate stained glass ceiling and sculpted interior are best experienced during a performance. Hotels in El Born are steps away.

experiences.name: Tapas Crawl on Carrer del Parlament
experiences.description: Graze through the vibrant Sant Antoni neighborhood's best tapas bars, sampling patatas bravas, jamón ibérico, and vermouth. This area has become Barcelona's top foodie hub with bars and restaurants clustered within walking distance.

experiences.name: Razzmatazz Club Night
experiences.description: Experience Barcelona's legendary nightlife at Razzmatazz, one of Europe's top clubs with five rooms playing different music genres. Located in Poblenou, it draws international DJs and a vibrant local crowd. Doors open late and the energy peaks after midnight.
